capability: A CLI --report failure never hides a committed Build receipt: every CLI build route prints the committed output's name, size and SHA-256 before writing the requested report, and reports a later report failure or cancellation as a partial success
searchEvidence: rg -n 'WriteReportJsonAsync|PrintReceiptAsync' src/NvtFwCombiner.Cli: four post-run call sites write --report before the result printer and CliBundleOptions.PrintReceiptAsync: CliApplication.StandardMerge.cs, AbMergeCliCommandHandler.cs, MergeCliCommandHandler.cs and ReplaceCliCommandHandler.RunSupport.cs (CompleteReplaceRunAsync, shared by ctrlram-replace and general-replace). The General Replace plan-only diagnostic Preview writes a report without a committed output and stays unchanged.

CliApplication.RunAsync catches only a requested cancellation, IOException, UnauthorizedAccessException and ArgumentException and returns 70 without printing the receipt; report serialization exceptions escape uncaught.

CompositionRunService: a loose additional delivery that fails or is cancelled after the primary commit keeps the run Succeeded, adds a delivery.<kind>.failed issue and sets IsDeliveryComplete=false; every CLI handler maps result.Succeeded to exit 0 and prints the issue on stderr. This committed-output-with-failed-delivery precedent sets the exit code for a failed report after commit.

AcceptedCompositionExecutionRequest.ReportPath is only a protected path inside the Application; the CLI alone writes --report through CliCompositionRunSupport.WriteReportJsonAsync, so the correction belongs to that CLI adapter owner, not CompositionRunService.
semanticOwner: CliCompositionRunSupport remains the only CLI owner of run-report writing; a result-aware WriteReportJsonAsync overload owns the order of the committed receipt (each handler's existing result printer followed by CliBundleOptions.PrintReceiptAsync) around the report write and the post-commit report-failure issue. The Standard Merge, AB Merge, General Merge and shared Replace handlers delegate to it; the Application run result and each handler's exit-code mapping are unchanged.
terminalContract: When a Build result carries a committed output, every CLI build route prints its receipt (Status, Profile, Output, Size, SHA256, Committed and any bundle receipt) before the requested --report is checked, serialized and written. A later I/O, access, argument or serialization failure, or a cancellation, prints one cli.report.failed partial-success issue on stderr, writes no Report line and keeps exit code 0, the same code the CLI returns for a committed output whose loose additional delivery failed. Preview, failed and other uncommitted runs keep the report-before-receipt order, their failure propagation and exit codes. A successful committed run writes the same report, now listed after the receipt; output bytes, names, ranges and report content are unchanged.

designReview.evidence: Bounded local R1 correction of the post-commit report and receipt order inside the existing CLI adapter owner, with no Application, profile, firmware byte, range or contract change.
